subject: English Home Language

show.line: Let's write n. A line down, then up and over one hump. n, n, nose!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says n, as in nose.
This letter says n. Say the sound!
Trace n with your finger. Down, then up and over one hump.
Look carefully. Which one is n? It has one hump.

hints: n has one hump. m has two.
Start at the top. Go down first.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write n for nose.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Down, up and over, up and over. Look, I wrote n!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is m. n has only one hump.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Down, then one hump. That is n!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter n, say its sound and trace it.
